Zoe (new-hire): hey team, day 1 here. company Windows laptop with WSL2 + Docker, tethering to my phone hotspot. SSH to bastion via jump often drops after a few minutes and I get git clone/pull DNS errors. using the split-tunnel WireGuard profile from onboarding. anyone seen this with tethered networks + WSL?

Marco (infra): welcome! yes — hotspots frequently change the 4-tuple and NAT mappings which kills long TCP sessions. WSL2 adds another layer (separate virtual NIC + resolver). two quick things: add ServerAliveInterval 20 and ServerAliveCountMax 3 to your ~/.ssh/config, prefer ProxyJump over ProxyCommand, and pin internal DNS inside WSL.

Leah (it-support): on Windows set the WG client to not override the default gateway (keep split-tunnel). For WSL: run `sudo rm /etc/resolv.conf && echo "nameserver 10.0.4.2" | sudo tee /etc/resolv.conf` and then `sudo chattr +i /etc/resolv.conf` to stop regeneration. Also we'll create a tether-friendly WG profile that includes the gitlab subnet in AllowedIPs.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance: bastion-redwood-1 reboot in 8m (maint-2026-07-10-2) :warning:

Ops Oncall: confirm 2c If you hit a disconnect around that time you likely landed on the host being restarted; try `ssh bastion -J jump.redwood` to land on a different bastion while we finish the rolling reboot.

Zoe (new-hire): pinned DNS in WSL and switched to ProxyJump + ServerAliveInterval. So far stable for 40m, and git pulls work. Thanks for the quick help!

Marco (infra): great — I'll add a short onboarding note: "tethered/home hotspots + WSL2: pin internal DNS, use ServerAlive*, prefer ProxyJump; ask IT for tether profile." Ping us if it crops up again.
